description.value: Gary's is a small, farm-to-table dinner restaurant in Vancouver's Fairview neighbourhood, sourcing from over a dozen named BC farms and producers including suppliers from the Fraser Valley, Bowen Island, and the Gulf Islands. The intimate space seats up to 26 at a long communal table or 36 standing, making it well-suited for a group meal at the end of a day's ride. Walk-ins are welcome, though space is limited on busy evenings.

bike_parking_detail: 7 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 45m; rack (4 spaces) at 53m; stands (2 spaces) at 53m; stands (2 spaces) at 54m; stands (2 spaces) at 62m; stands (2 spaces) at 66m; rack (5 spaces, covered) at 91m. Total: 19 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is available and confirms the business name, address (1485 W 12th Avenue), and that it is an operating dinner restaurant. The website details parking (no on-site parking; metered street parking on nearby streets) but makes no mention of bike racks, bike parking, water refill, washrooms, takeout, or any cyclist-specific amenities, so all such fields remain null. The dinner-only format (Tues–Sat from 5PM) limits daytime utility for touring cyclists.
